Refund_not_showing_up.what: A refund the customer was promised or requested has not appeared on their account or statement

activate_my_card.what: How to activate a new card, or activation failing

age_limit.what: Minimum age to open or use an account, or accounts for children

apple_pay_or_google_pay.what: Using Apple Pay or Google Pay, including topping up through them
apple_pay_or_google_pay.not_for: Top-ups made directly by card or bank transfer that failed (top_up_failed)

atm_support.what: Which ATMs accept the card, or where to withdraw cash

automatic_top_up.what: Setting up or the limits of automatic top-ups

balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer.what: Money the customer transferred INTO their own account has not shown up in their balance
balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer.not_for: A transfer the customer sent to someone else (pending_transfer, transfer_not_received_by_recipient); how to move money in (transfer_into_account)

balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash.what: A deposited cheque or cash has not shown up in the balance

beneficiary_not_allowed.what: A transfer could not be made because the recipient (beneficiary) is not allowed or not accepted
beneficiary_not_allowed.not_for: A transfer declined or failed for another or unknown reason (declined_transfer, failed_transfer)

cancel_transfer.what: Cancelling or reversing a transfer the customer already made

card_about_to_expire.what: The card is expiring or expired, and how to replace it

card_acceptance.what: Where the card can be used: shops, merchants, online
card_acceptance.not_for: Which countries the bank operates in (country_support); Visa vs Mastercard (visa_or_mastercard)

card_arrival.what: A card that was already ordered has not arrived yet, or tracking it
card_arrival.not_for: General delivery times or choosing a delivery date before ordering (card_delivery_estimate)

card_delivery_estimate.what: How long card delivery takes in general, or choosing delivery speed or date
card_delivery_estimate.not_for: A specific card that was ordered and is now late (card_arrival)

card_linking.what: Linking or adding a card the customer already received to the app

card_not_working.what: The customer's physical card does not work, without naming a specific declined payment or ATM
card_not_working.not_for: A virtual or disposable card that does not work (virtual_card_not_working)

card_payment_fee_charged.what: A fee was charged for paying by card

card_payment_not_recognised.what: A card payment on the statement the customer does not recognise
card_payment_not_recognised.not_for: The customer says the card itself is compromised and wants to secure it (compromised_card); an unrecognised direct debit (direct_debit_payment_not_recognised)

card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate.what: A wrong exchange rate was applied to a specific card payment or purchase
card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate.not_for: General questions about exchange rates (exchange_rate); cash withdrawals abroad (wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal)

card_swallowed.what: An ATM kept or swallowed the card

cash_withdrawal_charge.what: A fee was charged for a cash withdrawal

cash_withdrawal_not_recognised.what: A cash withdrawal on the account the customer did not make
cash_withdrawal_not_recognised.not_for: The customer made the withdrawal but got the wrong amount (wrong_amount_of_cash_received) or it is still pending (pending_cash_withdrawal)

change_pin.what: How or where to change an existing PIN
change_pin.not_for: Finding the PIN of a card or getting a PIN in the first place (get_physical_card); a PIN blocked after wrong attempts (pin_blocked)

compromised_card.what: The customer believes their card or card details have been stolen or used by someone else and wants to secure it

country_support.what: Which countries the bank, app or cards are available in

declined_card_payment.what: A card payment at a merchant was declined
declined_card_payment.not_for: A payment that went through and was then cancelled or reverted (reverted_card_payment?); a virtual card that does not work (virtual_card_not_working)

declined_cash_withdrawal.what: An ATM cash withdrawal was declined
declined_cash_withdrawal.not_for: The ATM gave the wrong amount of cash (wrong_amount_of_cash_received)

declined_transfer.what: A transfer was declined by the bank
declined_transfer.not_for: A transfer that failed or could not be completed (failed_transfer); a recipient that is not allowed (beneficiary_not_allowed)

direct_debit_payment_not_recognised.what: A direct debit or a debit taken by a seller that the customer does not recognise

disposable_card_limits.what: Limits and restrictions of disposable virtual cards, including how many can be made
disposable_card_limits.not_for: How to get a disposable card (get_disposable_virtual_card)

edit_personal_details.what: Changing personal details such as name, address or phone number

exchange_rate.what: General questions about exchange rates or how currency exchange works
exchange_rate.not_for: A wrong rate on a specific payment (card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate); exchanging money in the app (exchange_via_app); which currencies are supported (fiat_currency_support)

exchange_via_app.what: How to exchange one currency for another in the app

extra_charge_on_statement.what: An unexplained small extra charge, such as 1 pound or 1 dollar, on the statement
extra_charge_on_statement.not_for: A fee on a transfer (transfer_fee_charged); a pending card payment (pending_card_payment)

failed_transfer.what: A transfer the customer tried to make failed or could not be completed
failed_transfer.not_for: A transfer declined by the bank (declined_transfer); moving money into the account (transfer_into_account)

fiat_currency_support.what: Which currencies the customer can hold or exchange

get_disposable_virtual_card.what: How to get or what is a disposable virtual card

get_physical_card.what: Finding or getting the PIN for a card: where the PIN is, how to get a PIN
get_physical_card.not_for: Changing an existing PIN (change_pin); ordering a physical card (order_physical_card)

getting_spare_card.what: Getting an additional or spare card, and its cost

getting_virtual_card.what: How to get a virtual card
getting_virtual_card.not_for: Linking a card already received to the app (card_linking)

lost_or_stolen_card.what: The card is lost or stolen
lost_or_stolen_card.not_for: The phone is lost or stolen (lost_or_stolen_phone)

lost_or_stolen_phone.what: The customer's phone is lost or stolen, or they cannot access the app because of it

order_physical_card.what: How to order or receive a physical (plastic) card, and its cost

passcode_forgotten.what: The app passcode is forgotten or not accepted

pending_card_payment.what: A card payment is still pending

pending_cash_withdrawal.what: A cash withdrawal is still pending or not yet shown

pending_top_up.what: A top-up is still pending and has not completed yet

pending_transfer.what: A transfer the customer sent is still shown as pending
pending_transfer.not_for: How long transfers take in general (transfer_timing); money transferred into the customer's own account not showing (balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer)

pin_blocked.what: The PIN or card is blocked after too many wrong PIN attempts

receiving_money.what: How others, such as friends or an employer, can send money to the customer

request_refund.what: The customer wants a refund for a purchase or to cancel a purchase

reverted_card_payment?.what: A card payment that was made and then cancelled or reverted, or the money came back
reverted_card_payment?.not_for: A card payment declined at the time of purchase (declined_card_payment)

supported_cards_and_currencies.what: Which cards and currencies can be used to add money to the account
supported_cards_and_currencies.not_for: How to top up by card (topping_up_by_card)

top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge.what: Fees for topping up or receiving money by bank transfer
top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge.not_for: A fee charged on a transfer the customer sent (transfer_fee_charged)

top_up_by_card_charge.what: Fees for topping up by card

top_up_by_cash_or_cheque.what: Topping up with cash or a cheque

top_up_failed.what: A top-up attempt failed or the card was declined while topping up
top_up_failed.not_for: A top-up that is still pending (pending_top_up); a top-up that went through and was later reverted (top_up_reverted)

top_up_reverted.what: A top-up that went through was later reverted or cancelled, or the money disappeared after it
top_up_reverted.not_for: A top-up that failed at the time (top_up_failed)

topping_up_by_card.what: How to top up the account with a card, or others topping up the account

transaction_charged_twice.what: The same transaction was charged twice

transfer_fee_charged.what: A fee was charged on a transfer the customer sent
transfer_fee_charged.not_for: Fees for topping up or receiving money by bank transfer (top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge); an unexplained small charge (extra_charge_on_statement)

transfer_into_account.what: How to transfer money into the account from another account

transfer_not_received_by_recipient.what: A transfer the customer sent has not reached the recipient
transfer_not_received_by_recipient.not_for: How long transfers take in general (transfer_timing)

transfer_timing.what: How long transfers take to arrive
transfer_timing.not_for: A specific sent transfer that the recipient has not received (transfer_not_received_by_recipient)

unable_to_verify_identity.what: The customer cannot complete identity verification

verify_my_identity.what: How to verify identity and which documents are needed

verify_source_of_funds.what: Verifying the source of the customer's funds

verify_top_up.what: Verifying a top-up or the card used for top-ups

virtual_card_not_working.what: A virtual or disposable virtual card does not work

visa_or_mastercard.what: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard, or choosing between them

why_verify_identity.what: Why identity verification is required, or using the account without it

wrong_amount_of_cash_received.what: The ATM gave a different amount of cash than requested

wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal.what: A wrong exchange rate was applied to a cash withdrawal abroad
